text:
dani: FYI support ticket opened: several customers reporting p99 latency ~2.5-3x higher after last rollforward. customer examples attached from support.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime-v21 -> runtime-v22 at 5301234500, cohort=canary(5%), rollout=gradual
dani: timeline matches — spike started ~5301234520. p95 also up but less dramatic. p99 most visible. customers on EU region primarily.
oliver: can someone run a p95/p99 timeseries split by kernel variant + seq_len bucket? start with 10m windows from 5301234400 to now.
maya: running quick prometheus queries now, will paste results in ~5
maya: query: rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{handler="generate"}[5m]) by (le,kernel_variant)
maya: results show kernel=new-kern-3 has a heavy tail for >512 tokens, older-kern-2 is fine :thinking_face:
ravi: interesting — did kernel selector change in v22? I thought we left selector stable for canary.
deploy-bot: changelog for v22: kernel-selector tuning enabled for long-seqs; default weight adjustments applied
dani: @ravi can you confirm which commits enabled kernel selector change? we need commit id to bisect.
ravi: yep, commit a1b2c3d toggled selector: selector/weight-adjustments. I can quickly roll that out to canary-only toggle off.
support-bot: support ticket 84721 updated: customers A,B impacted; provided sample request ids: rid=abc123, def456, ghi789
oliver: repro attempt: sent a synthetic 600-token request to canary endpoint — p99 ~1.2s higher vs baseline. attached trace shows kernel switch attempt + extra kernel init on one worker.
oliver: trace snippet:
```
[runtime] dispatch -> choose kernel new-kern-3
[new-kern-3] warmup: fetch-kernel-binaries 120ms
[new-kern-3] init-kcache 80ms
[generation] token-step 7ms (baseline 4ms)
```
maya: that warmup on new-kern-3 could explain tail. maybe cold binary fetchs are happening under load due to latebinding.
ravi: mitigation options: 1) toggle selector to prefer old-kern-2 for canary traffic; 2) pin kernel variant in routing table for high-seq tenants; 3) increase canary traffic to exercise warmups (not great); 4) roll back v22.
sre-jen: recommend quick mitigation: 5% -> 0% canary (pause rollout) and set selector to previous weights, then observe for 10m.
dani: agreed. @deploy-bot can you patch rollout to freeze (stop increasing) and reduce canary to 0% while we evaluate?
deploy-bot: rollback-plan: canary traffic reduced to 0% at 5301234620, immutable: false
deploy-bot: applied config: routing.cohorts.canary.percent=0
ravi: also toggled selector back to old weights via featureflag selector.runtime.weights=stable at 5301234630
maya: re-running p99 chart — noise dropping in EU region within two windows. preliminary p99 down ~40% at 5301234680
oliver: next steps for root cause: bisect the runtime change path: (a) kernel selector weights, (b) kernel binary packaging location (cdn change?), (c) runtime prefetch logic in a1b2c3d.
dani: let's capture a reproducible request and do an instrumented run with debug logging for kernel selection. need to avoid prod blast; run on staging with traffic mirroring for sample id rid=abc123.
oliver: repro steps:
1) mirror sample request rid=abc123 to staging-canary
2) enable debug logging: LOG_LEVEL=debug COMPONENT=kernel-selector
3) run 50 requests at qps=2 for 600-token sequence
4) collect traces (+perf counters) and compare kernel fetch times
please confirm someone will run
ravi: I'll run steps 1-3 on staging now and paste logs
ravi: staging log excerpt:
```
5301234701 [kernel-selector] chosen=new-kern-3 score=0.71 (fallback: old-kern-2)
5301234701 [fetch] request kernel-binary new-kern-3 size=24MB time=138ms
5301234701 [init] kcache allocate time=92ms
```
ravi: looks like binary fetch time ~130-140ms on first use; in prod with a few concurrent requests this spikes p99 because fetchs sometimes queue on network/disk
maya: hypothesis: change in v22 moved new-kern-3 binaries to a slower CDN edge; or we added latefetch for memory savings.
oliver: can we avoid fetchs on hotpath by prefetching during startup? or keep selector from choosing new-kern-3 until it's prefetched for node.
sre-jen: medium-term fix: prewarm kernel binaries on node bootstrap for variants likely to be used. short-term: prefer old-kern-2 for sequences >256 until prefetch landed.
dani: action list:
- [x] freeze rollout & reduce canary -> 0% (deploy-bot)
- [x] revert selector weights to stable (ravi)
- [ ] run staging mirroring repro & gather traces (ravi)
- [ ] open infra ticket to investigate CDN / packaging change (maya)
- [ ] follow up with customers with ETA (support)
support-bot: support ticket 84721: note actions taken and ETA = 2 hours for root cause triage
dani: thanks team. once we have bisect evidence we'll decide: hotpatch prefetch or full rollback of a1b2c3d. keep updates here and ping #incidents if customer impact grows :thumbsup:
